title: Text Size Setting
description:
Adds readability options to the game's own settings menu: [b]Text Size[/b], an [b]Easy-to-Read Font[/b], and [b]High-Contrast Card Text[/b].

[h2]How to use[/h2]
Open [b]Settings > General[/b]. You'll find three new rows:
[list]
[*][b]Text Size[/b]: use [b]-[/b] / [b]+[/b] to pick anything from 70% to 200%.
[*][b]Easy-to-Read Font[/b]: switches the game's text to Atkinson Hyperlegible, a font the Braille Institute designed for low-vision readers. Letters that look alike (I, l, 1) are made clearly different.
[*][b]High-Contrast Card Text[/b]: makes the text on cards bright white with a thick black outline. Coloured card text keeps its colour, just brighter. Only cards change.
[/list]
Changes apply right away, even in the middle of a battle, and are remembered next time you play.

[h2]What it changes[/h2]
Text across the game's interface: cards, menus, tooltips, the HUD, events and more. Text never spills out of its button, box or frame. Where a box has room for another line, text wraps to stay big; where space is really tight, it grows as much as fits.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
No other mods required. Doesn't change gameplay or saves. Languages the readable font doesn't cover keep the game's own font. Unsubscribe to remove it and everything goes back to normal.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
